# Deng Ai Format & Crypto Utilities (Storefront 03)
> Fast deterministic tabular data conversion to Parquet, cryptographic hash verification, and SQL dialect formatting.

## Production Endpoint Base URL
https://warungjovalga.shop

## Endpoints
- POST /csv-to-parquet: High-velocity conversion of CSV text chunks to Apache Parquet binary format in <150ms. Price: $0.35 USDC
- POST /verify-hash: Cryptographic proof verification (SHA256, Keccak256, EIP-712 checks) in <20ms. Price: $0.10 USDC
- POST /format-sql: Deterministic SQL query dialect sanitizer and formatter in <40ms. Price: $0.25 USDC
